facts.statement: SOE apologized to players for inconvenience caused by a recent service interruption affecting its games, including Free Realms.
facts.quote: Queremos disculparnos por cualquier inconveniente que los jugadores hayan experimentado como resultado de la reciente interrupción del servicio

article_summaries.title: ¡Sólo este sábado! Doble Station Cash (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post from roughly late April 2011 announcing a one-day double Station Cash promotion on Saturday April 30 across SOE's games, apologizing for a recent service interruption, and saying SOE was preparing a repair plan for PS3 players of DC Universe Online and Free Realms. It gives no details of the repair plan, which was to be posted later on the game sites and forums. The post is a site-wide SOE notice; Free Realms appears only in the PS3 repair line.
